This '''[[Droid/Legends|droid]]''' was an aspiring actress who went to talent school to achieve this. She was a girlfriend of [[F-29-PSKx]], who called her multiple times from a [[Star*Link]] booth from the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] [[Tomorrowland Starport|spaceport]] while traveling.<ref name="Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Seen on Star*Link monitor. A typical droid beauty???|Lady Droid's description in ''Complete Guide to Star Tours''|<ref name="Guide" />}}
The background for this droid comes from a "Spot the Droid" poster displayed at the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']], which was translated at the EndorExpress.net fan site<ref name="EE">{{EndorExpress|url=star-wars-adventures/star-tours/2013/05/retro-tokyo-a-look-back-at-tdls-star-tours-before-it-was-updated|text=Retro-Tokyo! A look back at TDL's Star Tours before it was updated...}}</ref>, as well as the ''[[Complete Guide to Star Tours]]'' booklet.<ref name="Guide" />

The droid was likely to have been a 'drag' redress of F-29, shot before the ride opened.
